title: Margins
author: a court wizard
pages: Fire, water, earth and air. Ice and lightning are the same four, only angry. Mending is the fifth, and nobody argues with it.
Death and Blood. Every court forbids them and none of them remembers why. I asked the old master once. He looked at the door before he answered, and then he did not answer.
The crucible hums when the flux runs high. The apprentices say it talks. It does not talk. It listens, which is worse.
If you hear your own name in it, put the lid on and go outside. Do not answer. Somebody answered, once, a long time ago.
